data.narrative:
Onodrim Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Aistis Šimaitis, Alexander Blessing, and Christian Garrett, having raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed and Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €40M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $100M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence); the median across this set is $1.0B, reflecting substantial heterogeneity in the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $85M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $550M. The wide dispersion reflects two material uncertainties: the substantial stage gap between Onodrim's seed position and the predominantly Series A peer set, and structural differences in technical risk, market access, and customer traction across the Defense & Security landscape. The stage-progression method's $100M result anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables—particularly UFORCE at $1.0B in Seed stage—support the higher-end scenarios.
